profile.headline: System Software Engineer, Training and Inference Performance @ NVIDIA
profile.summary: Research and engineering for hardware-software co-design of various AI workloads

positions.title: Staff Engineering, Product, Model Inference
positions.description:
Inference performance on vLLM, SGLang, MLC.

Launched: 
OctoStack. A fully airgapped E2E AI Inference solution for F500s and closed its first customer.

positions.title: CTO, Co-Founder
positions.description:
Architected and delivered an end-to-end secure payment infrastructure, successfully facilitating over $XX MM in secure transactions globally, emphasizing privacy, security, and reliable transactions safety at scale.

Built ML-driven recommendation engines and autonomous AI agents for financial services. 

Architected the design and implementation of technologies utilizing advanced Multi-Party Computation (MPC), contributing novel solutions in privacy-preserving algorithms and secure distributed systems.

positions.title: Systems and Networking Researcher
positions.description:
CacheBuilder: I developed a userspace mechanism to reduce packet drop rates on high speed network fabrics using RDMA and explicit L3 cache control.

CortexSuite: I developed low level C-kernels for popular ML, NLP, and CV algorithms, widely used by industry and academia for accelerator, compiler, and machine learning optimization. 

Particle: I built an analytics engine and scheduler for large-scale data processing tasks and improved application runtime by 3x and cold start by 84% compared to existing SOTA methods.

positions.title: Software Engineer - AI/ML Search Safety
positions.description: I worked with the Google Brain team to develop deep learning models for search and adspam detection using TensorFlow-like internal tools leveraging the latest NLP techniques.

publications.title: NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 2: An Accurate and Efficient Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Reasoning Model
Nemotron-H: A Family of Accurate and Efficient Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Models
